gameLocalization.note: Names follow paired Canto IX part 1 and part 3 records. The guide aliases for Dazzle, Closing Time, Ingredient Harvest, the exhibition passive, and Artwork: Tibia are resolved by their game IDs. Jab uses Combatant skill 9103701; Bondage uses passive 133201 rather than the Binds E.G.O. Shared Ampules, first-half and second-half debuffs, rescue conditions, carried-over HP, unknown resistances, and event ending conditions are retained.

lead.text: Fight alongside Hohenheim and Alisa. Weaken major attacks with Sinner attacks before the NPCs clash with them. In the second half, incapacitate Albina first to reduce Callisto's Protection and Assist Defense.

listLead.text: Fight alongside 2 allied NPCs. Weaken major skills with Sinner attacks before leaving them to NPCs. Later, incapacitate the Apprentice first to reduce the Nursefather's Protection and Assist Defense.

statNote.text: Faust, Sinclair, and Ishmael are the three required Sinners. Everyone, including the NPCs, shares the remaining K Corp. Emergency Ampules. Albina carries her current HP into the second half. Viewing the Tableau lowers Callisto's Offense and Defense Levels by 20; she gains 7 Protection while Albina can fight. Corpus Theater is listed at 74 HP, but use the individual unit's display. Unconfirmed resistances are marked unknown.

skillNote.text: Both Automanikins' Liberation of Bones have inconsistent Power ranges and Coin listings, so Base Power and displayed Power are marked unconfirmed. Liberation of the Repressed Flesh after the armor is removed is treated as having 1 Atk Weight. Check the actual predictions and targets before skills resolve.

priorities.0.text: Land three separate attacks before the major attack. Do not take over the NPC's clash enabled by Dazzle.

priorities.1.text: Have the fastest Sinner clash with the enemy not using the major attack to reduce Assist Defense.

priorities.2.text: Rescue captured allies and keep both NPCs from dying.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: The NPC loses the clash against a major attack

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: Land three separate attacks on the major attack's user before Hohenheim clashes with it. If Assist Defense intercepts them, clash with the assisting enemy directly first.

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Callisto gains 7 Protection while Albina can fight. Incapacitate Albina first in the second half to stop both the Protection and assistance.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: A Sinner disappears and cannot be controlled

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: They are trapped in Corpus Theater. If anyone other than Callisto defeats the corresponding enemy unit, the ally returns next turn. Coordinate the rescue with Alisa's targets.

units.0.notes.0.text: Once per encounter, clears Stagger and immediately ends the turn when Staggered. Iron Curtain precedes the second half.

units.0.notes.1.text: Unlike 9-18, progression does not use the 60% HP condition. Watch for the transition triggered by Stagger.

units.1.notes.0.text: Withdraws when the second half begins. Defeating them earlier earns SP and reduces incoming Bleed and buffs.

units.2.notes.0.text: Withdraws when the second half begins. Defeating them earlier earns SP and reduces incoming Bleed and buffs.

units.3.notes.0.text: Viewing the Tableau lowers Offense and Defense Levels by 20. At Turn Start, gains 7 Protection if Albina can fight. This differs from the Mirror Dungeon version's 70% final damage reduction.

units.3.notes.1.text: The Closing Time event begins around half HP. You do not need to reduce HP to 0.

units.4.hp.text: 1,352 (carries over current HP from the first half)

units.4.notes.0.text: This is not a fresh, full HP bar. Incapacitate her before focusing on Callisto in the second half.

units.4.notes.1.text: Even skills with the same names have different Offense Level differences and Corpus Ingredient gain conditions from the first half.

units.5.part.text: A unit corresponding to a captured ally

units.5.notes.0.text: Burn is effective alongside Wrath and Blunt damage. Do not assume unconfirmed resistances are neutral.

units.5.notes.1.text: If anyone other than Callisto defeats it, the ally returns next turn. If Callisto defeats it, the captured ally is incapacitated.

phases.0.title.text: Prepare healing for the three required Sinners and the NPCs

phases.0.steps.0.text: Recommended Lv. 60. Level Faust, Sinclair, and Ishmael, and bring HP/SP recovery and strong clashers.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Hohenheim handles major attacks; Alisa helps clear adds and rescue allies. You lose if both die. The five Ampules are shared by everyone, so do not spend them all on the Sinners.

phases.1.title.text: Clear the Automanikins and weaken the armored major attack

phases.1.steps.0.text: Stagger and defeat the Automanikins early to gain actions and SP. The turn after Muscular Contraction, Automated Myofiber Activity makes Coins Unbreakable. Avoid assigning Sinners with high Bleed to take those hits.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Resolving a Sloth attack before Liberation of Bones consumes Automated Myofiber Activity at the end of that attack. However, Unbreakable conversion is determined at Combat Start; do not assume all Coins revert.

phases.1.steps.2.text: When Repressed Flesh appears, land three separate attacks first. Three Impact-rattled Armor lowers Final Power by 30. Dazzle makes it target Hohenheim without redirection, letting the NPC handle the clash.

phases.1.steps.3.text: Staggering Albina clears her Stagger and immediately ends the turn. During Iron Curtain, reflected damage is multiplied by 20. Hold back attacks and prepare for the second half.

phases.2.title.text: Focus on Albina and stop the support skill

phases.2.steps.0.text: The Automanikins withdraw and Albina removes her armor. Callisto gains 7 Protection while Albina is active, so focus on Albina first.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Win the clash against Callisto's Oh, How We Love the Flesh and the Blood to prevent 6 Offense Level Up on Albina. Do not ignore it because its Base Power is low.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Handle regular attacks based on current Bleed and clash predictions. If NPC assignments and rescues allow, evading Albina's feeding skill can also limit Corpus Ingredient gains.

phases.3.timing.text: Turns when an area attack is equipped

phases.3.title.text: Clash with the assisting enemy first, then land three attacks on the major attack's user

phases.3.steps.0.text: The enemy not using the area attack intercepts unopposed attacks through Assist Defense. Have the fastest Sinner clash with that enemy directly to reduce its value by 1. Check the remaining stacks and add clashes as needed.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Once assistance is reduced, land separate attacks on the major attack's user before it acts. After the armor is removed, each attack applies 1 Plus Coin Drop and 1 Power Down, up to three times. This differs from the first half's −30 Final Power.

phases.3.steps.2.text: Then let Hohenheim attack with guaranteed Heads. Three attacks are ideal; if that is impossible, aim for at least two and prepare healing for the damage taken.

phases.4.title.text: Rescue captured allies before Callisto reaches them

phases.4.steps.0.text: Improvised Ribcage is Unclashable, cannot be redirected, and prevents Defense Skills from activating. Destroy the Corpus Theater it creates instead of trying to defend with the captured Sinner.

phases.4.steps.1.text: Alisa helps with rescues. Check her target and have Sinners supply any missing damage. Do not leave a rescue unattended: Callisto defeating the unit incapacitates the ally.

phases.4.steps.2.text: A rescued ally returns next turn, and you gain 2 resources of every affinity. Use them for healing and preparation for major attacks, and keep both NPCs from dying.

phases.5.title.text: Proceed from Closing Time to Alisa's last resort

phases.5.steps.0.text: After incapacitating Albina, damage Callisto. Around half HP, she clears Stagger and immediately ends the turn. Closing Time turns everyone except Alisa into Corpus Theater.

phases.5.steps.1.text: Do not try to stop the Unclashable event skill that prevents Defense Skills from activating. Alisa's last resort rescues everyone and ends the battle.

skills.27.effects.14.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 1 Damage Down next turn

skills.27.effects.15.text: [On Hit] Gain 1 Damage Up next turn (once per skill)

skills.27.response.text: This weakening differs from the armored version's −30 Final Power. Land three attacks to apply 3 Plus Coin Drop and 3 Power Down before Hohenheim's clash.

skills.28.response.text: Starts with 1 Assist Defense. Consume it by clashing with Albina directly, allowing early attacks to reach Callisto's major skill.

skills.29.effects.2.text: Cannot be Staggered until this skill is used

skills.29.effects.4.text: [On Use] If the target has at least 6 Bleed, Coin Power +1.

skills.29.effects.5.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Fragile next turn.

skills.29.effects.7.text: Ⅱ [On Hit] Inflict 1 Power Down next turn

skills.29.effects.8.text: [On Hit] Gain 1 Power Up next turn

skills.29.response.text: A Clashable Counter used only for Assist Defense. Clash with the assisting enemy directly first to reduce interception.

passives.0.effect.text:
At Turn End with 2 Corpus Ingredient, remove it next turn and gain Artwork: Fascia.

At Turn Start with Artwork: Fascia, use a powerful attack this turn.

Before using the powerful attack, gain 1 Impact-rattled Armor when damaged by an attack skill.

passives.0.condition.text: 2 Corpus Ingredient; preparing a powerful attack

passives.0.response.text: The weakening method changes depending on whether Albina is armored. Check her current form.

passives.1.effect.text:
Take 30% less HP/SP damage and Stagger Threshold increase from Burn, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking.
Take 50% less Bleed damage.

passives.1.response.text: Reduces damage from Bleed and other statuses. Do not simply wait for statuses to work; weaken major skills and focus your attacks.

passives.2.effect.text: If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.

passives.2.response.text: SP returns to 0. Maintaining Panic alone is not a complete strategy.

passives.3.effect.text: When gaining a buff that changes Panic Type, Panic Type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.

passives.3.response.text: Do not assume changing Panic Type will disable dangerous skills.

passives.4.effect.text:
At Turn Start while not Staggered, gain 2 Protection, 10 Defense Level Up, and Shield equal to 10% current HP.

For each use of Repressed Flesh this encounter, reduce these gains by 1 Protection, 5 Defense Level Up, and 5 percentage points of Shield.

passives.4.response.text: Work around the early defenses by clearing Automanikins first. Using Repressed Flesh weakens the defensive buffs.

passives.5.effect.text:
While not Staggered, when damaged by an attacker's final Coin:
- Deal Pierce damage to the attacker equal to 20% of that Coin's damage and inflict 2 Bleed (max 100 damage per skill).
- This effect's damage cannot Stagger.

passives.5.condition.text: Taking damage from a final Coin while not Staggered

passives.5.response.text: Avoid Iron Curtain's reflection and concentrate attacks on turns preparing Repressed Flesh.

passives.6.effect.text: When Staggered, clear Stagger and end the turn (once per encounter)

passives.6.response.text: Unlike 9-18, Stagger itself triggers progression. After Stagger is cleared and the turn ends, do not keep attacking into Iron Curtain.

passives.7.effect.text: If the main target has 3 or more types of negative effects, Final Power +1

passives.7.condition.text: Main target has at least three types of negative effects

passives.7.response.text: The enemy gains Power. Avoid concentrating attacks on Sinners with accumulated Bleed and debuffs.

passives.8.effect.text: If the main target has 3 or more types of negative effects, Final Power +1

passives.8.condition.text: Main target has at least three types of negative effects

passives.8.response.text: The enemy gains Power. Avoid concentrating attacks on Sinners with accumulated Bleed and debuffs.

passives.9.effect.text:
At Turn End, if Corpus Ingredient is at 2, remove it next turn and gain Artwork: Fascia.

At Turn Start with Artwork: Fascia, use a powerful attack this turn.

Before using that attack, when damaged by an Attack Skill, gain 1 Plus Coin Drop and 1 Power Down (once per skill, up to 3 times per turn).

passives.9.condition.text: 2 Corpus Ingredient; preparing a powerful attack

passives.9.response.text: The weakening method changes depending on whether Albina is armored. Check her current form.

passives.10.name.text: Visitors Must Respect the Rules of the Gallery

passives.10.effect.text: With Assist Defense active, reduce it by 1 at Clash Start (once per skill)

passives.10.condition.text: Clash Start with Assist Defense active

passives.10.response.text: Have the fastest Sinner clash with Albina directly and exhaust her assistance before attacking Callisto.

passives.11.effect.text:
On an Attack Skill hit, if the user inflicts a negative effect and gains a positive effect simultaneously, heal 4 SP.
- If this recovery occurs at max SP, gain 1 Haste next turn (up to twice per turn).

passives.11.condition.text: Hits that both inflict a negative effect and grant a buff

passives.11.response.text: Allowing hits also restores SP. Use resistance and healing to handle Coins that remain after a clash win.

passives.12.name.text: The Pulse and Beat of Corpus-turned-Ingredient

passives.12.effect.text:
HP damage, SP damage, and Stagger Threshold advancement from Burn, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking are reduced by 30%.
Bleed damage taken is reduced by 50%.

At Turn End, gain 1 Defense Level Down next turn per 4 Burn on self (max 15).

Fascia, made from Albina's blood and flesh.
Albina has only her brain left, while Fascia lacks only a brain.
This poses the question of which one truly possesses the body.

passives.12.response.text: Burn works well with the NPCs and lowers Defense Level, but prioritize required clashes and removing assistance.

passives.13.name.text: With this Artwork, I will Prove Myself before the Maestro

passives.13.effect.text: When the Ring Nursefather appears, if the user's SP is below 20, set it to 20

passives.13.response.text: Albina's SP returns to 20 if it is lower. Do not use her first-half SP for predictions.

passives.14.effect.text: If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.

passives.14.response.text: SP returns to 0. Maintaining Panic alone is not a complete strategy.

passives.15.effect.text: When gaining a buff that changes Panic Type, Panic Type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.

passives.15.response.text: Do not assume changing Panic Type will disable dangerous skills.

passives.16.effect.text:
At Turn End, with 206 Corpus Ingredient (Bones) and 5 Corpus Ingredient (Blood), consume both amounts and gain 1 Artwork: Tibia.

At Turn Start with Artwork: Tibia, use a powerful attack this turn.

When damaged by an Attack Skill while preparing to use the powerful attack, gain 1 Plus Coin Drop and 1 Power Down (once per skill, up to 3 times per turn).

Tibia: a masterpiece carved and completed by pouring in every part of her own body.

passives.16.condition.text: 206 Bones, 5 Blood, and preparation for a powerful attack

passives.16.response.text: When Tibia's Melody appears, prepare three separate early attacks and the NPC's clash.

passives.17.name.text: Allow Me to Briefly Enjoy My Pupil's Exhibition

passives.17.effect.text: With Assist Defense active, reduce it by 1 at Clash Start (once per skill)

passives.17.condition.text: Clash Start with Assist Defense active

passives.17.response.text: Clash with Callisto directly to reduce Assist Defense and let early attacks reach Albina's major skill.

passives.18.name.text: The Aesthetics of Harvesting and Trimming the Ingredient On-site

passives.18.effect.text: At Skill End, if the skill dealt damage, gain 30 Corpus Ingredient (Bones) and 1 Corpus Ingredient (Blood) per target

passives.18.condition.text: End of a skill that dealt damage

passives.18.response.text: Hits supply ingredients. Stop dangerous skills and check preparation for major attacks every turn.

passives.19.name.text: Please, Do Stop Running and Be Seated

passives.19.effect.text: At Turn End, inflict Ingredient-shedding Wound next turn on the fastest Sinner and assistant

passives.19.response.text: Fast Sinners receive Offense Level Down. Check whether early attackers can still win required clashes.

passives.20.effect.text:
On entry, heal 30 SP.

On an Attack Skill hit, if the user inflicts a negative effect and gains a positive effect simultaneously, heal 4 SP at Attack End.
- If this recovery occurs at max SP, gain 1 Power Up next turn (once per turn).

An art that shapes combat using the opponent's bones and muscles as on-site materials. As the process continues, even small bone fragments become increasingly intricate weapons.

passives.20.condition.text: On entry and buffs from hits

passives.20.response.text: Starts at 30 SP. Check current SP as well as the base values.

passives.21.name.text: All of My Corpus has been Given to Tibia

passives.21.effect.text:
HP and SP damage from Burn, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking are reduced by 30%.
Bleed damage taken is reduced by 50%.

At Turn Start, if Staggered, clear Stagger. Then gain 2 Wrath Fragility and disable Installation Art no. 3: Improvised Ribcage through the next turn (once per encounter).

At Turn End, gain 1 Defense Level Down next turn per 4 Burn on self (max 15).

passives.21.response.text: The first Stagger is cleared. Use Burn to lower Defense Level, but check actions after Stagger is cleared too.

passives.22.effect.text:
When Artwork: Tibia expires, heal the following units for 30 SP and grant them 2 Offense Level Up and 2 Defense Level Up next turn:
- The Ring Nursefather - Callisto
- The Ring Apprentice - Albina
- Corpus Theater

passives.22.response.text: The major attack is followed by enemy SP recovery and Offense/Defense Level buffs. Prepare for the next regular skills too.

passives.23.effect.text:
If HP falls below 50%, clear Stagger and end the turn.
- At the start of the next turn after this effect activates, equip Closing Time - Installation Art no. 1: Your Flesh and Bones as the Gallery's Seats in the last slot.

passives.23.response.text: Clears Stagger, immediately ends the turn, and proceeds to Closing Time. Continue to Alisa's ending event instead of trying to reduce HP to 0.

passives.24.effect.text: If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.

passives.24.response.text: SP returns to 0. Maintaining Panic alone is not a complete strategy.

passives.25.effect.text: When gaining a buff that changes Panic Type, Panic Type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.

passives.25.response.text: Do not assume changing Panic Type will disable dangerous skills.

passives.26.effect.text: If the Ring Nursefather defeats Corpus Theater, its linked character is incapacitated

passives.26.response.text: The captured ally is incapacitated. Have a Sinner or NPC destroy it first.

passives.27.effect.text:
If anyone other than the Ring Nursefather defeats Corpus Theater, apply the following:
- Its linked character returns next turn; if their SP is below 10, set it to 10.
- Lower the Ring Nursefather's and Ring Apprentice's SP by 10.
- Gain 2 of every E.G.O resource.

passives.27.condition.text: Someone other than Callisto defeats Corpus Theater

passives.27.response.text: The ally returns next turn, and you gain 2 resources of every affinity. Avoid wasting too many actions on the same rescue as Alisa.

passives.28.effect.text: Take twice as much Burn damage

passives.28.response.text: Takes double Burn damage. Use it to help Alisa rescue allies.

passives.29.effect.text:
Apply the following to the character linked to Corpus Theater:
- Cannot act.
- Buffs, HP, and SP do not update.

passives.29.response.text: The captured character cannot act. Rescue them with the remaining Sinners and NPCs.

mechanics.0.effect.text: When taking lethal damage while another ally is alive, clear Stagger and fully restore HP. Every ally's remaining Ampule count decreases by 1 simultaneously.

mechanics.0.response.text: Everyone shares the initial five uses. They are also needed to revive NPCs; this is not five uses per Sinner.

mechanics.1.effect.text: While not Staggered, the final attack slot cannot be redirected and prioritizes Hohenheim. Expires at Turn End on the turn it activates.

mechanics.1.response.text: Check the NPC's clash and have Sinners weaken the enemy with earlier attacks.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Maximum 2. Damage +15% per stack. At 2, convert all attack Coins to Unbreakable at Combat Start. Expires at Attack End.

mechanics.2.response.text: Resolve the Sloth skill before Liberation of Bones to consume the damage buff.

mechanics.3.effect.text: Before Repressed Flesh is used, taking damage from an Attack Skill grants 1 stack, once per skill, up to 3. Each stack lowers that skill's Final Power by 10.

mechanics.3.response.text: Build stacks with three separate attacks, rather than one three-Coin skill.

mechanics.4.effect.text: Maximum 2. Albina gains it through hits and other effects, then uses it to prepare Artwork: Fascia.

mechanics.4.response.text: Hits from Unbreakable Coins also add ingredients. Prepare early attacks for the next major skill.

mechanics.5.effect.text: At Turn Start, gain 4 Base Power Up. Attack Skills that inflict Bleed inflict 2 additional Bleed Potency. Expires after the major attack.

mechanics.5.response.text: Account for the buff on top of the listed base values. Early attacks apply different debuffs in the first and second halves.

mechanics.6.effect.text: Maximum 206. Gained at the end of skills that deal damage and through other effects. With 5 Blood and 206 Bones, prepares the next Artwork: Tibia.

mechanics.6.response.text: Stop Callisto's regular skills, then land early attacks when the major skill appears.

mechanics.7.effect.text: Maximum 5. Gained at the end of skills that deal damage and through other effects. Used with Bones to prepare the major attack.

mechanics.7.response.text: This is separate from Albina's Corpus Ingredient, which caps at 2.

mechanics.8.effect.text: At Turn Start, gain 4 Power Up and 2 Slash Power Up. Attack Skills that inflict Bleed inflict 2 additional Bleed Potency. Expires after the major attack.

mechanics.8.response.text: Do not judge from Base Power alone. Weaken the skill with early Sinner attacks before the NPC clashes with it.

mechanics.9.effect.text: Base Offense and Defense Levels −20. At Turn Start, gain 7 Protection if Albina can fight.

mechanics.9.response.text: The table includes the fixed level reduction. Defeat Albina first in the second half to stop Protection.

mechanics.10.effect.text: On Skill Use, gain 2 Offense Level Down, up to three times per turn.

mechanics.10.response.text: Lowers the fast Sinner's clash Power. Check predictions for the Sinner removing assistance too.

mechanics.11.effect.text: The captured ally cannot act, and HP, SP, and other values stop updating. A corresponding enemy unit appears.

mechanics.11.response.text: Have someone other than Callisto defeat it to rescue the ally, then wait for their return next turn.

mechanics.12.effect.text: You lose if all Sinners and assistants become Corpus Theater.

mechanics.12.response.text: Keep Alisa able to rescue allies. The late Closing Time event leaves Alisa free and leads into her last resort.

warnings.0.text: You lose if both NPCs die. Remaining Ampules are shared by everyone, rather than being individual use counts.

warnings.1.text: Major attacks are weakened differently in the first and second halves. Distinguish −30 Final Power from three Armor stacks from the later Plus Coin Drop and Power Down.

warnings.2.text: Clash directly with the enemy that has Assist Defense first. Simply assigning unopposed attacks to the major skill's user lets them be intercepted.

warnings.3.text: Do not let Callisto defeat Corpus Theater; the captured ally will be lost.

warnings.4.text: Resistances, Protection, and actions differ from the 9-43 event battle and the hidden Mirror Dungeon boss.

preparation.0.text: Recommended Lv. 60 with Faust, Sinclair, and Ishmael. Bring HP/SP recovery and strong regular skills or E.G.O.

preparation.1.text: NPC Burn is useful, but prioritize early attacks and removing assistance. Blunt, Sloth, and Gluttony damage are effective.

roles.0.name.text: Early clashes to reduce Assist Defense

roles.0.reason.text: Keep attacks meant for the major skill's user from being intercepted by the other enemy.

roles.1.name.text: Early attacks against the major skill's user

roles.1.reason.text: Use separate attacks to weaken the skill enough for the NPC to win.

roles.2.reason.text: Prevent the NPCs and Sinners from all dying or being trapped, and spend resources on healing.

messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)9-37「アルビナ・カリスト（9-37）: Albina & Callisto (9-37) guide for Limbus Company 9-37. Fight alongside Hohenheim and Alisa. Weaken major attacks with Sinner attacks before the NPCs clash with them. In the second half, incapacitate Albina first to reduce Callisto's Protection and Assist Defense.
